paper_title: AttentionInfluence Adopting Attention Head Influence for Weak-to-Strong   Pretraining Data Selection
caption: The statistics of clustering. The left is the clustering result of AttentionInfluence, the right part is that of FineWeb-Edu Classifier.
model_annotation: This chart set displays a comparison of clustering results, with one pie chart representing the clustering of AttentionInfluence and the other the FineWeb-Edu Classifier. Each chart is divided into multiple segments representing distinct categories, with the AttentionInfluence chart showing 16 categories and the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart displaying 15 categories. In the AttentionInfluence chart, the segments are labeled "Policy 1," "Manage 2," "Emerging tech 4," "Materials 3," "Infor tech 5," "Events & people 6," "Society & culture 10," "Historical review 7," "Materials 2," "Animal & Plant 13," "Nutrition 5," "Medical 6," "Health & Medicine 22," "Diseases 11," "Science & technology education 19," and “Healthy education 2,” and colored in shades of blue, green, orange, and purple, with approximate proportions ranging from 2% to 23%. Several slices are visually emphasized through an exploded or offset presentation. The segments appear generally ordered by decreasing size. The FineWeb-Edu Classifier pie chart includes segments labeled "Manage 1," "Emerging tech 4," "Materials 1," "Infor tech 3," "Events & people 2," "Society & culture 5," "Teaching & resources 17," "Healthy education 2," “Science & technology education 19”, “Materials 3,” “Animal & Plant 12,” "Diseases 10,” “Medical 2,” and “Nutrition 7,” and presented in hues of orange, yellow, and green, whose proportions range approximately from 1% to 38%. Both charts include a legend and percentage labels directly within each slice.
